_doc: Guns and missiles (openspec/changes/weapons-and-shields sections 1, 4 and 6; coop-drill design 2.3-2.4). A gun's bolt leaves at speed_mps plus its ship's velocity. sigma_rate_k is degrees of aim error per degree per second of the target's angular rate across the line of sight. A turret fires only when its hit chance is at least min_hit_chance.
